label: seed-variance-monthly-n10
_why:
WAS THE BUILDING EVER CREATED, OR DID IT NOT SURVIVE THE FIRST YEAR? (user question, 2026-08-17)

The previous variance run read the FIRST save summary, which at a yearly autosave interval is 1837.1.1 - a full in-game year after the buildings are placed. Everything in between is AI behaviour: construction, bankruptcy, annexation, and the nationalise-or-delete the user proposed for a port whose owner cannot supply it. So its 6/10, 7/10 and 8/10 readings do NOT distinguish "never created" from "created and then lost", and those are different defects with different fixes.

This run uses MONTHLY autosaves and reads 1836.2.1 - one month after init, before the AI has meaningfully acted. Comparing the two answers it: a country that is 10/10 here but 7/10 at 1837 was created every time and destroyed sometimes; one that is 7/10 here was never created in three runs.

PRIOR (yearly reading, same config): ORG 0/10 · ABU 6/10 · SMB 7/10 · TID 7/10 · PON 8/10 · everything else 10/10. ORG is separately explained: vanilla's anchorage in STATE_WASHINGTON is owned by c:HBC, the Hudson's Bay Company - a THIRD party, neither ORG nor GBR - and ours assigns GBR. It is the only seeded state whose vanilla port belongs outside the state's own country, and the only 0/10.

CONTROL: the three leaders' own created industry. At the yearly reading steel_mill ranged 4-11 levels across identical runs while shipyard_metal and motor were flat, which is world-wide steel churn rather than a create failure - at one month it should be flat too, and if it is not, the create mechanism is implicated after all.
_arms: canon = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.json} - grants are NET-only, ACE and LAN removed. All ten runs identical; the only difference is the game's RNG.
_comparison: Not an arm comparison. The output is a variance envelope, against which 20260817_155024 (all grants), 20260817_184940 (leaders only) and 20260817_200536 (ace only) can finally be judged — or dismissed.
_cost: 10 runs x 3 in-game MONTHS, ~15 minutes total.
_caveats: ⚠ The BINV boot dump is NOT usable for this: its ~12k-line burst overflows the log ring and the mirror loses about 3% of it at random, which already produced spurious differences in states we never touched (Benin, Dahomey, Bhavnagar). Save summaries come from the savegame and are unaffected. ⚠ Two in-game years so a 1837.1.1 autosave exists; nothing economic can be read from a run this short and nothing should be. ⚠ L19: check for an orphaned victoria3.exe before launching — one live game from a previous batch makes every subsequent run fail in ~20 seconds with a single-line log and a misleading SCHEDULE DONE. With ten runs queued that would waste the whole batch. ⚠ L17: a run that fails is still recorded `ok` by the harness; check each meta.json before counting it.
